This video explains law firm leverage, the economic model that allows equity partners to scale their work through teams of lawyers and associates and how artificial intelligence could change it all. (Produced by Paul Detrick; Senior Producer Andrew Satter; Executive Producer Josh Block) (Source: Bloomberg)
